Predict from Trained Penalized Regression Models on a New MAE

Source: R/pen_regression_models.R
predict_pen_reg_models.Rd

Applies models trained by train_pen_reg_models to a new MultiAssayExperiment (test set, validation cohort, or future data). Survival outcome and clinical covariates are extracted directly from colData(mae_pred) and colData(mae_train).

Usage

predict_pen_reg_models(
  mae_pred,
  mae_train,
  omic_list,
  integration = c("none", "early", "late"),
  model_method = c("cox_lasso", "cox_adaptive_lasso", "cox_elastic_net", "aft_pen"),
  clinical_vars = NULL
)

Arguments

mae_pred

A MultiAssayExperiment object containing the data to predict on, built with build_MAE after aligning features via prepare_test_SE.

mae_train

A MultiAssayExperiment object containing fitted models in metadata(mae_train)$analysis, produced by train_pen_reg_models.

omic_list

Character vector of assay names to predict on. Must match those used in train_pen_reg_models.

integration

Character string specifying the integration strategy used during training: "none", "early", or "late". Default is "none".

model_method

Character string specifying the model to retrieve: "cox_lasso", "cox_adaptive_lasso", "cox_elastic_net", or "aft_pen". Must match the model_method used in training. Default is "cox_lasso".

clinical_vars

Character vector of column names in colData to append as covariates. Must match those used during training. Default is NULL.

Value

mae_pred with results stored in metadata(mae_pred)$analysis:

  • "none" / "early": per-assay results at [[model_method]][[assay_name]], containing test (predictions) and metrics (Harrell + Uno C-index).

  • "late": per-omic results as above, plus ensemble results at $late_integration[[model_method]][[tag]] (where tag encodes the integrated omics), containing test and metrics. The late_method is retrieved automatically from mae_train metadata.

See also

train_pen_reg_models, prepare_test_SE, build_MAE
